notes.title: 1.76.0 update is now up
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/6cb3e3bfb0a293ab3eea3c9e716701705d85deab.png"][/img]A new Item slot has been added: Accessories[/p][p]The new slot unlocks at e425, with all items being craftable, sports 10 items, all of which belong to existing item sets - allowing you to mix and match your gear more, while maintaining a powerful full set bonus! To accomodate this a bit more, the void set has been updated with a new bonus and the empowering shoulderguards are now a 4% incantation enchant gearpiece. Versatility has been moved to e725, instead, to stop confusing players as to whether it's worth investing or not early on (spoiler: it's not).[/p][p]Also included: Ranger and Shapeshifter-themed Orbs and a Ranger-themed Spellhound/Arcanaworg.[/p][p]And a lot of various significant and minor bug fixes[/p][p]Come visit us![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.74.0 update is now up
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/f13730b52bf5f07794f41f3c190d5429ecfedbc8.png"][/img][/p][p]Pantheon mechanics have been reworked![/p][p][/p][p]New Feature: Temple. You now possess a number of Acolytes, which you can assign to specific Gods to pray to them, while free Acolytes will instead grant progress towards gaining Boons (Offerings, Scriptures, Tenets). Boons gain this speed nonlinearly, and rarer Boons require more Acolytes available at once. You can invest these Boons into specific Gods to various effects: Offering double XP gained for an hour, Scriptures boost XP gained and Tenets increase either the first or the second Ability Power, with both Scriptures and Tenets lasting until Realming. Excess Offerings can also be used for Rites (instantly gaining 30 minutes of Gods XP for each God with an Acolyte, costing 1 Offering per active God).[/p][p]Gods level scaling and requirements were changed. The Major Gods' total levels are now roughly 10 lower while retaining roughly the same total bonus, Minor Gods are roughly twice lower with the same bonus. Gods now have an additional mechanic of Goals, gaining a multiplier on top of their bonus on specific levels (5th, 10th and every 10th afterwards).[/p][p]Acolytes are gained through gaining Pantheon-related Paragons, reaching specific maximum levels among all Gods (10, 25 and every 25th afterwards) and Renown.[/p][p]Attention: Paramnesics were reset to allow for investing into "Misleading Insight".[/p][p][/p][p]Related to Pantheon rework:[/p][p]- "Misleading Insight". New Paramnesic that increases Splinter income.[/p][p]- "Overlapping Cycle" Imprint changed. Now increases God XP gained until the corresponding God reaches their all-time max level again.[/p][p]- "Contraligia" Minor God. Bonus changed. Splinter income moved to the new Paramnesic.[/p][p]- "Mundigenia" Minor God. Bonus changed. Total bonus for Enchanting Dust spread between base rates, Legacy bonuses and Trial Milestones (see "Balance").[/p][p]- Enchanting dust gain increases from Legacy doubled.[/p][p]- Enchanting dust gain increases from Trial milestones reshuffled and significantly increased overall.[/p][p]- Base Enchanting dust income increased by 56%.[/p][p]- Minor Gods now always drain XP at base XP gain rate and all XP bonuses affecting Minor Gods increase drain (previously "Minor Gods xp gain" bonus did not increase drain).[/p][p]- Base God XP rate is now twice as low, which is compensated by being able to invest offerings (doubled XP gain) while also gaining new ones with the higher amount of Acolytes than Gods selected previously.[/p][p]- Renown reward for simultaneous Gods replaced with Acolytes amount, with values increased.[/p][p][/p][p]Among other changes:[/p][p]- "Head Of The All-Eater" weapon. Reworked. Now grants a passive bonus that depends on Exile's total stats. Bonus formula reduced (x2 less), will still result in a larger bonus on average given the significantly bigger amount of stats accumulated compared to the previous charging period.[/p][p]- Added Realm History, displaying information about last 20 Realms.[/p][p]- Changed the format of displaying item bonuses. Now the bonus from Masterworks/Exhibits/Breakthroughs/Proficiency is shown after the total bonus in form of "(+X%)".[/p][p]A lot of various significant and minor bug fixes[/p][p]Come visit us![/p]

notes.title: The 1.73 update is now up
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/7bf8d97368078aecfdb3e0777a57fc09145f8931.png[/img]

New Mythic mechanic: Masterworking. A new way to upgrade Mythic items that increases all Inherent bonuses, rolled bonuses and Imbuements.

Also includes:
- 4 new Mythics (2 for both Legs and Back slots).
- Mythic items amount cap increased to 25 (was 20).
- 3 Heritages and 1 Paramnesic were added last patch.

Some minor rebalance and buffs, several bug and stability fixes included.

Check it out!

notes.title: The 1.71 update is now up
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/c2bc8b7a30a00ac01362bb1659a05a042b4a5345.png[/img]

New Mythic mechanic: Imbuement. Allows you to expand the functionality of your Mythic items by adding up to 2 new powers (Imbuements) to them. First, you select a specific pool of Imbuements to choose from, then the resulting power is selected from that pool at random.

Also includes:
- 4 new Mythics and 2 new slots (wrist and belt), 2 items each.
- Mythic items amount cap increased to 20 (was 15).
- Item sets received new, powerful bonuses when completed, and had some of the other bonuses rehashed.

Several bug and stability fixes included.

Check it out!

notes.title: The 1.69 update is now up
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/efc243813fdc16bda5c5226ec88446a5ef1bb081.png[/img]

We've finally integrated translations into the game - Russian language is available, while German and French are available via machine translation for now. We also intend to add more languages with community's support. Keep in mind there's a select few sections of the game still untranslated - soon to be finished.

Another highlight of the patch is the removal of the Forge. Forge is no more! All the items are always available.

Some quasi rebalances, bug fixes and a lot of typos and ambiguous phrasing fixed.


It is also Christmas Season in Idle Wizard!

We at TwoWizards wish you a Merry Christmas!

Starting from December 16th and up to January 16th, log in to receive numerous gifts!

Check out some new visuals, try out Christmas skins for additional merriness!

Come join us for the celebration!

notes.title: 1.66 update is now up
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/8b19289e53d7e1fd4f4f5e7ba51c8b9fc33b197b.png[/img]

New Feature: Quests. An expanded tutorial/introduction comprised of a series of tasks with rewards, mostly aimed towards explaining the game's basic mechanics to new players.

Manual reset of Memories removed, Memories can now only be reset when Realming. Choose wisely!
"Unseen Efficiency" and "Unending Resource" Heritages have been removed from the game. You now permanently possess a bonus to Enchanting Dust and Catalyst Shards earned roughly equal to what you'd possess if you invested all of your Memories into either "Unseen Efficiency" or "Unending Resource".

New Enhancement Spells available: "Spirit Of Valor" and "Conjure Void Elemental", available from completing the "Redemption" and "The Great Crusade" Quasi-Realms, respectively.
New Imprint: Forged Affinity. Allows you to retain some of your Attribute Points after Realming.

And a couple of bugfixes and balance tweaks.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.64 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/66ff314773bd4c26ece015a062940ed6e65fd49a.png[/img]

New feature: Trophy upgrade - Exhibits
Exhibits function not unlike Breakthroughs, allowing Trophies to increase the power of their basic bonuses. Exhibits are earnable through Expeditions and drop the same way Trophies drop initially, after the corresponding Trophy has reached Legendary quality.

A couple of new enhancement Spells were introduced: Jas'Aham's Missile Storm Spell, Nightfall and Primal Power.
Exhibits also come with a new Imprint and a Paramnesic: Pseudo-Fossils, a new Imprint that allows for carryover of Exhibits, and Exaggerated Spoils, a new Paramnesic that increases Expedition rewards.

Some of the previous Enhancements have also received buffs, and Fire Ball has been reworked.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.63 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/40b5fd8cf3b1926ee58b4f0911d2389297c01507.png[/img]

New Quasi-Realm featuring Abolisher with a unique Doppelganger's attributes feature and a switchable Pet, and an Abolisher portrait to go along with it.

Enhanced "Rules of Nature" and "Fireball" Spells, obtainable from the "Rainforest" and "Feral Abyss" Quasi-Realms, respectively.

Most Classes and Pets no longer require time, offline time or idle time spent to unlock them or had it made simpler (hooray!).

And a couple of bugfixes and balance tweaks.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.61 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/4936d6c641df6a8c1aea06a5fb8e5763dda72d07.png[/img]

A new Quasi Realm with a unique Class - the Nosferatu, along with its unique visuals, spells and effects. It utilizes both Liquid Shadow and Blood - a new unique resource of the class.

Nosferatu comes along with a new background, cursor, orb and 2 portraits available for customization.
A couple of offline features have also been improved, including offline Heart of the Grave functionality.
Check it out!

notes.title: 1.57 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/8e184bf0444ce84a9b7e86a085a14e84e4042a60.png[/img]

Offline progress has seen a couple of significant improvements - autoclicks now count offline, based on your average autoclicks (same as Spellcasts). Auto Idle expedition now works offline up to 24h, including key-locked ones.

Renown bonuses have been boosted, and Spell Sets were made baseline (now you always possess 10 sets, same as items) and thus removed from Renown. Multiple bonuses were either moved earlier or introduced to them.

A batch of of new Character and Pet skins!

Balance tweaks - Branch of the Great Cycle is now way more powerful, do mind that the display was changed to represent the difference with a normal summoning spell, so the number might look lower than it was (in reality, it's way higher now).

Trophies now drop more readily and in higher amounts now, both normal and key-locked ones.

We've found and fixed a notorious case where Spell sets could disappear when saving other sets, which many players reported.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.56 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/6a759e7e5b9a3b2aa24b7f0e578d405fb0c53ca5.png[/img]

A new Quasi Realm with a unique Class - the long-requested Cryomancer, along with its unique visuals, spells and effects. Even your game's screen shall freeze! We're also planning to release more quasis with new classes from time to time - stay tuned :) We're still intent on making an Ironsoul and Abolisher quasis to cover everyone, of course.

A lot of Summoning spells that previously served little purpose, like Conjure Elemental, Automaton or demonic summons, have been granted accumulated tags and new effects that scale off casts and/or summon efficiency, making them rather worth to have.

We have also introduced a couple of new items that help with Summoning duration to better stack these updated summons, as well as buffed some set bonuses and introduced an incantation efficiency enchant in the finger slot (finally!).

Instead of Elementals, Archon gets a completely new spell that buffs some of the pet's stats and spell charges.

It's also worth mentioning that we have made some balance changes, due to accumulating some data on how classes perform comparatively to each other, as well due to recent changes granting some classes more power where it wasn't intended.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.53 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/d996efed43ed02b2a7e1701dca999714e8a27c5c.png[/img]

A small content and tech patch, including a new Quasi-Realm featuring a rather different Umbramancer, a couple of new cosmetics and some balance fixes.

Hard reset button also moved out of the harm's way!

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.48 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/a386e0d2f82bc9d52ff9019b6abb507723d5cd98.png[/img]

A new item slot: Phylactery.
An empowered gem not unlike a Soul Shard. They bestow bonuses that scale off the Character level and usually combine positive effects with a negative one.

We've also added the long-promised Calendar window - click the small calendar icon in the bottom right-ish corner you'd usually look up the weekly or event details on to check on our Event and Weekly schedule!

Regional prices are now a thing!

A renewed Steam page, along with the new, up-to-date, trailer is also here now.

2 new Triumphs to achieve!

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.47 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/c36cfca833ed56d667ff89eda4bf2310ebab8b96.png[/img]

Corruption Feature. It's new Collectable type - can reward Relics, Alteration Sands, Crafting Dust, Memetic Splinters, Ingots and Ink, Breakthroughs, Pet and Character experience (a new, separate bonus that adds flat experience amount based on your Character experience totals) . Trials and Experiments no longer yield Relics (so you're no longer obliged to wrap your head around dumping them en masse or not - feel free to!). Stacks up to 12 instances (~day, offline too!). Spawns once per 125 minutes.

Bats also yield Character experience the same way now.

Some bugfixes, like accounting for multi-enchanting for Trials, or finally fixing an esteemed 3 years old bug that made Innovation grant half the Research item craft progress on crits instead of doubling it (as intended).

And a new Triumph!

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.45 update is now up!
notes.notes:
Tech and QoL patch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/eb1b6a6bbf4f9613ba6defd2c64ee3df6161ef18.png[/img]

New offline feature: Spellcasts! They now count during offline time (only actual time with the game closed counts, doesn't include Timewarps or Wormholes). This works through using your current spells' cast rate - which means this also includes casts gained through others means like Berzerker, Jas'Aham's Missile Storm, etc.

We've enabled custom cursors for the first time since Temporal Conflux update - years have passed since then! You can enable/disable them in the options.

Animated backgrounds have been visually intensified, since we've received feedback that animations were hard to notice.

A lot of bugfixes and small changes like Cataclysm's charges and being able to invest all Memories with an alt-click into uncapped Memory Upgrades.

And a new Triumph!


Check it out!

notes.title: 1.44 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/aea3eec960eb0ea427690f6bc07e80341f6dda15.png[/img]

A big visuals and GUI update! We've implemented animated elements for more than half of existing backgrounds and a new animated background. The Character selection screen was reworked to give you a much better overview. The orbs and background previews can now display their respective animations, orb preview reworked to use new visuals.

Automatic expeditions are now a cheap, separate purchase and can be also upgraded to improve the win chance. If you had Renown VI before - you will automatically get it. Renown VI is now also cheaper and more powerful, but doesn't grant auto expeditions anymore.

Alteration sand purchases are now x1.5 more efficient per Relic spent.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.43 update is now up!
notes.notes:
A bunch of stuff all around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/76c57aa23d8fd0306055aa24d3581710b458c876.png[/img]

Innovation Trial rework: Breakthroughs. When you have all Research items at Legendary, Innovation trial will instead reward you with Breakthroughs that increase the bonus of a Research item for the rest of the Realm. The reward is distributed at random, but the chance for the specific Research to receive the Breakthrough is directly tied to the item's current enchant level - with enchant level 0 guaranteeing it does not receive them.

- 5 new Triumphs
- You can now set a personalized name for Item and Spell sets!

And a lot more various qol and fixes, from simultanous item+spell sets switching or finally making Tempest's 7th spell shown on spellsets and having a hotkey to reworking Scales of Appraisal and buffing Zenith!

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.37 update is now up!
notes.notes:
A bit technical patch in preparation for Spell Memetics update coming next. Included are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/1306043dc0f14e96cb818f9e1563a2a3550a6c57.png[/img]

A Spell Shards pool and Shards distribution rework
All Spell Shards gained are now accumulated into the reworked Shards Pool and then 10% of your total is distributed into your selected spells every 0.1 second. The Pool has an upgradeable cap of Shards it can accumulate that maxes out at e7 and higher for Abolisher and Archon through respective pets' perks.

Some balance and core changes (see full patchnotes ingame):
- Base mana source costs reduced.
- "Psychic Cacophony". New ability at level 700 - increase amount of Arcanasprings, equal to (level - 700).
- Forbidden Might. Now has a maximum level of 10, price increment reduced from 8e5 per level to 5e5 per level.
- Void Memetic. Trap bonuses for Void Profits and Void per Entity increased from x1.5 to x2 per Trap's level, from x1.24 to x1.5 for Liquid Shadows.
- "Soulstealer" pet. Evolution to "Psychic Cacophony" now available at 325.
- "Spellstaff Of Chamaon" spell. Now increase Evocation efficiency as an additional effect, with Incantation efficiency scaling of ^0.8.
- Trial of Valor. Spells' cooldown reduced in half.
- Temporal Stabilizer weapon. The gap between Common and Legendary quality drastically reduced, Legendary quality bonus unchanged.

And quite a bit of other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.35 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/377dd9eec163f02aee1570549d60f8a1279c1b71.png[/img]
New item slot: Mounts
A series of items with unique bonuses that mostly augment stacking phases in various aspects. Unlike regular items, only 2 of the Mounts can be crafted - other 4 can be acquired by completing various activities.

Balance:
- Auto-trial mode is now a baseline feature (was unlocked by Paragon 28).
- Leg item slot unlock moved up to to Paragon 25 (1e360) (was Paragon 26 at 1e380).
- Versatility attribute is now unlocked at Paragon 28 (1e425) (was Paragon 25 at 1e360).
- Oni and Ironsoul classes. Stances' power formula now works as if you had at least 1 cast performed (used to start from 0).
- Upgrades unlocked through a manual click requirement now require a certain amount of autoclicks instead.
- Geode and Ley Keeper pets. Effect duration reduced, bonus to all attributes increased, bonus to chosen attribute reduced, now boosts an attribute going in order from first to last, instead of being random.
- "Slavedriver" challenge. Rebalanced, reward changed.

- 32 new achievements
- Item slots in crafting menu now have enchanting level labels.

And quite a bit of other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.34 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/9e00299057c2a5039cf3ae5653dfafbe6fecb6df.png[/img]

The Defiance. New Ascension form, can be accessed by Archon, Oni and Shaman.
Shares Nullzone, Unclean Knowledge and Nightfall spells, and grants the Employ Celestial Countermeasures spell - a Permanent Incantation that boosts Evocation and Summoning efficiency.
Defiance's unique feature is switching between two sub-forms that have different Character Abilities - a Voidmana Per Entity as a buildup form, and a Transcendent form that has an individual ability dependent on your basic Character Class.

- Spellcast rate counters that show individual spell's rate - including fake sources like JMS or Berzerker. 
- Increased Dust per pack in the market - for the same price.

And some minor balancing changes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.32 update is now up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/c7b5b908885ecb826359a18963bc138d537c2b71.png[/img]

The Dread. New ascension form, can be accessed by Heretic, Desolator and Temporalist.
Increases Gods' main ability power. Shares Voidbolt, Artificial Muse and True Sorcery spells, and grants the Manifest Twisted Reality spell - a Permanent Evocation that boosts Character Ability Power and Idle profit bonus.
Dread's unique feature is a second Pet slot. The secondary pet cannot be of the same evolution tree, and you can only utilize one T3 Pet at a time. Pet Ability Power affects the secondary Pet at a square root of normal Pet Ability Power.

New decorative feature: Bat Hunter skins! 5 for now, and we'll keep making more over time.

Base crafting dust income increased by 12%. Greater Chimaera and Simulacrum pets crafting dust bonuses were removed - no need to sit on Chimaera to stack dust anymore.

And some minor balancing changes.

Check it out!

notes.title: 1.31 update is now up!
notes.notes:
A big QoL patch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/ca2a9028fc60b2ccb54e121129a1d78ed12bb6a5.png[/img]

New legacies, achievements and Steam achievements. Steam Paragon achievements have been redone in favor of Legacy levels.

Gate to the Past should be fixed and display the time properly now!

Almost all windows can now be closed by using their respective hotkeys, e.g. pressing N a second time will close the Interiors window.

Upgrading items now yields a constant amount of progress instead of a random one (on average, upgrading items became cheaper). No more fishing for Perfects!

Item and Spell presets now saves for each pair of Class+Ascension Form. Switch and try out those with ease!

And some balancing:

A swath of changes to Shaman and their Pets - less upfront power, more power with long and real long exiles. More upfront power on Risen Giant with less capability for time scaling.

Psychic Cacophony now starts less powerful, but grows way faster with Levels, and has a tad more Pet Ability scaling to it. 

Demonologist is now way more playable and accessible from the start, and a bit stronger overall.

And quite a bit of other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.26 published
notes.notes:
1.26 update is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/9290cff98a53b4404a9ba809c43ae60390192921.png[/img]

Void Memetics are now unlocked at e650 and hugely buffed, including a new bonus accumulated through excess echoes gathered. Accordingly, Catalyst Memetics are now unlocked at e750 and Red Power has been significantly toned down. 

A big rebalance (and quite some nerfs) of 1e2000+ upgrades.
4 new backgrounds and 5 new orb skins included, and you can now toggle on/off all of the UI with F10 key to see backgrounds in all of their glory!

Long awaited feature of de-selecting Gods by clicking on them also included.

And some other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.25 published
notes.notes:
1.25 update is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/be8d56c33f396122ce25cd6316d9324b24784837.png[/img]

A new tab of Memory upgrades called Imprints was added. Memory Upgrades from this tab are mostly aimed at easying the transfer from one Realm to another - from preserving Catalysts to granting you more Memories upon switching Realms. They utilize a separate pool of Memories, equal in amount to the Memories utilized for old Memory Upgrades.

Some upgrades were rehashed, and a grand total of 7 new memory upgrades was added.
4 new backgrounds and 7 new orb skins included!

And some other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.23 published
notes.notes:
1.23 update is now up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/ea9eb2009d4fb15e87ece16ff74e0826ebaee790.png[/img]

New feature: Minor Gods.
Minor Gods are now available at e1000 Mysteries mark. These new Gods provide bonuses to a variety of stats and work similarly to the usual Pantheon Gods, with the exception of leveling method - instead of gaining experience on their own, they leech it off their "parent" Gods as long as they (new minor ones) are active. The leeching speed is twice the speed of experience gain by old Gods.

Renown II now grants +1 to the max amount of chosen Gods. All other same bonuses in Renown levels increased by 1, up to 3 (was 2). 

Two new Memories that increase the cata/edust-derived multipliers to Memories gained. Time multiplier from Memories formula changed.

Desolator and Heretic balance changes.

And some other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.22 published
notes.notes:
1.22 update is now up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/789a73846577f7e042f0627b1f070a3432d81933.png[/img]
We've made some long-needed changes that disencourage constantly stacking Cata shards for Memory profits, and encourage pushing more Mysts.

Some buffs and reworks centered around Voidterror also got in, including a scaling buff to Void Radiance.
We've also got a nice set of 7 new Orb skins and 4 new wonderful Backgrounds!
And some other minor stuff and fixes.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.14 published
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow Wizards!

Patch v1.14 is live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/f9ccbe7ef0eef1bdf7cdcc05a7b48148a041e3b0.png[/img]

We've finally migrated the game to Unity 2021, hopefully this will have some positive effects on performance.
This also might introduce some unwanted side effects, so keep an eye out.

There's also a bunch of new stuff, like new skills: Praying and Mentalizing, a new God memory and an option to mass-use Experiments.

Some Memories have also been buffed, Light of the Eighth Star (the jar capacity neck) is now more powerful.

Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.12 published
notes.notes:
It's Christmas Season in Idle Wizard!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/cf548960dbb344676e9227f3a1f918a8b29619e3.png[/img]
We at TwoWizards wish you a Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Version 1.10 published
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/9a4c57062ad8e26837b858d91cf70886f05ccc36.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow Wizards!

Patch V1.10 is live!
With a bunch of new stuff available:
- Utilize a new type of currency to augment your Void Traps. When you unlock Memetics, a new mode for your traps will become available. Those do not grant Void Mana, but instead provide bonuses, and possess experience and levels. The bonuses include Void profits, mana per entity, Traps' experience and spawn speed and increase with the Trap's level. They accumulate a new type of entities (called Echoes) over time, which, when collected, provide experience to their respective trap. You are still able to access old Void Traps by switching those inside the Memetics menu, and they still function in the background for the purposes of Radiance, Voidmancer ability etc. The Echoes accumulate slowly, and stack up to 5 (15 with a new memory upgrade), so you only need to check on them once in a long while. They also work offline. 
- We're removing Super-crits and have rebalanced basic crits to compensate the potential profit loss. The reason for this is Supercrits are pretty unstable in terms of profits, work a bit weird and hard to understand.
- The crafting dust income is now higher than it was in the pre-Realms part. The amount is tuned to it's the same as before once all upgrades are maxed.
- The Memories Upgrades are massively reworked. There is 10 new upgrades available, and overall amount of profit available is greatly increased. However, Memory Upgrades are now locked by total amount of Memories earned on individual basis, meaning a set of them is available from start, and a lot of later ones open up as you earn more and more Memories.

(This means that Memories invested are reset for everyone. Re-invest wisely.)

- We're finally adding a big set of new higher-level achievements like total buildings etc. suitable for higher Mysts levels, and a few more Legacy levels.
- 19 new skins, and skin inheriting for the Pets similar to what Character classes have.

notes.title: Version 1.05 published
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327637/4e7836bf7249e51deb2f68d4f7fee1021d0b3e46.png[/img]
Greetings, fellow Wizards!
Patch V1.05 is live!
- A major rework of Expeditions, with a deck-building mechanic, available spells roster expanded drastically, and new content like monsters, enemy spells, locations and a couple of new combat mechanics added.
- Pet Skins! A lot of you have been asking about this for ages, and they're finally there. We don't have too many on start (after all, characters skins have been built up to what they're now for years), but now we have the ability to add a couple here and a couple there. Abolisher and Archon pets supported, too! We're starting with a unique skin for each T3 Pet and around 10 simpler skins for various T1-T2 Pets, and will be adding more over time with small patches.
- A rework of Experiments. This has been a long time coming, we've remade the one unified Experiment into separate categories with uneven or single-type costs, and thus are attempting to make Crafting Dust colors unique in purpose (unlike now, where they're basically the same). Our goal is to also implement some more ways to spend Crafting Dust in future.
And some other minor fixes and updates.
Major note: Due to this, we're abolishing the Trade Week!
With the way the crafting will work from now on, trading with 100% efficiency won't allow us to make the dust feel unique, and will allow for abuses that we won't be able to balance out. Naturally, it'll be replaced by another, new one not related to trading Dust.
A few weeks later we'll be publishing the second part of the patch (v1.1), which will introduce a new core-game mechanic along with some more content and balancing based on feedback.

notes.title: Version 1.02 published
notes.notes:
Core mechanics:
- 3 additional item presets.
- 32 new upgrades.
- Green catalysts gain cap now starts at 1000. This can be increased by a new memory upgrade.
- Completed trials value can now be increased by new memory upgrade.
- Spells' and Weapons' values that scale from mana sources now include additional sources (like the ones gained from red catalysts).

Balance:
- Some of the upgrades costs rebalanced.
- Convertion rates into memories rebalanced.
- Green catalysts drop in expedition reduced overall. Blue catalysts drop in expedition increased.
- Catalysts drop in expeditions now diminish as you earn more within a short period of time. The amount is then gradually restored over time.
- Idle expedition now continues the run up to 100% after losing a battle instead of abandoning it. No reward is given for the lost encounter, but further ones are unaffected.
- Time of idle expedition is now based on encounter difficulty and your level.
- Forge. Potential amount of slots increased to 12 (was 6), base amount of slots is 2 (was 1).
- Forge. Base speed of recovery doubled.
- "Expanded Mind" Memory upgrade. Maximum level increased to 10 (was 2), the cost was reduced and rebalanced accordingly (base cost is greatly reduced, but the overall sum is now greater).
- "Temper The Steel" spell. Passive effect reworked, the old effect is now scales from current amount of casts (changed to an active effect). New persistent effect.
- "Gem Resonance" spell. Now scales from mysteries.
- "Voidlight Amalgam" pet. Void profits bonus scaling increased.
- "Planned Progress" Memory upgrade. Now increases Idle and Offline bonus.
- Mechanos Apexis pet. Scaling from pet active time when it's over 3 days is now stronger.
- Abolisher main ability bonus increased.
- Alchemist main ability bonus increased.
- Ironsoul main ability and berserk stance bonuses increased.
- Desolator elixirs bonuses increased.
- Temporalist. Scale from time and skipped time increased.

And many bug fixes.
